verdict.rationale: Langfuse explicitly documents SDK/API-based, non-UI workflows: CI/CD experiments to block deploys on regressions, a CLI for terminal/coding-agent use, Python/JS SDKs for querying and running experiments, and self-hosted Docker/Kubernetes deployment—all enabling fully headless automation pipelines. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of a real CI pipeline run and more detail on non-interactive auth/config for automated environments.
